login.feature.repository.title: Centralized documentation

login.feature.access.title: Controlled access

login.feature.future.title: Ready to evolve

upload.title: Upload documents to the workspace

knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
knowledge.description: Group workspace documents to prepare the context your agents will use.
knowledge.createDescription: Select stored documents and assign them a shared purpose.
knowledge.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what agents will use this base for.
knowledge.documentsHelp: You can create an empty base and add documents later.

agents.description: Define workspace agents and assign knowledge bases to prepare their behavior.

agents.editDescription: Update the agent configuration and publish it again when it is ready.
